inputs.name: componentFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that componentFiles converts to PascalCase for the component file name and label default, and to kebab-case for the test file name and the data-harness-component attribute. The function does no validation or escaping of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to those conversions.

inputs.name: viewFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that viewFiles converts to a kebab-case route segment for src/routes/<route>/+page.svelte and the data-harness-view attribute, and to a spaced title for the page heading and document title. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to those conversions.

inputs.name: layoutFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that layoutFiles converts to a kebab-case route segment for src/routes/<route>/+layout.svelte and the data-harness-layout attribute. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to that conversion.

inputs.name: apiFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that apiFiles converts to a kebab-case segment for the src/routes/api/<route>/+server.ts path and the resource value that GET returns. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to that conversion.

inputs.name: storeFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that storeFiles converts to camelCase for the store file name, to PascalCase for the create<Name>Store function, and to kebab-case for the test file name. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to those conversions.

inputs.name: hookFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that hookFiles converts to camelCase for the exported <name>Hook handle and its src/hooks file name, and to kebab-case for the test file name. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to those conversions.

inputs.name: e2eFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that e2eFiles converts to a kebab-case route for the tests/e2e spec file name, the page.goto path, and the data-harness-view selector. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to that conversion.

inputs.name: partialFiles.name
inputs.description: The scaffold name that partialFiles converts to PascalCase for the <Name>Partial.svelte file name and label, and to kebab-case for the test file name and the data-harness-partial attribute. The function does no validation of its own, so any string, including an empty one, is passed unchecked to those conversions.

outputs.name: componentFiles
outputs.description: The two planned files for one component, in order: the Svelte component at src/components/<PascalName>.svelte and its test at test/components/<kebab-name>.test.ts. The function only returns these PlannedFile objects and does not write them to disk.

outputs.name: layoutFiles
outputs.description: The two planned files for one route layout, in order: src/routes/<route>/+layout.svelte and test/routes/<route>-layout.test.ts. The function only returns these PlannedFile objects and does not write them to disk.

examples.contents:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';

	let { children }: { children?: Snippet } = $props();
</script>

<section data-harness-layout="reports">
	{#if children}
		{@render children()}
	{/if}
</section>
